versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation to focus on VVR 11.8+ with clear upgrade guidance for older jobs.
- Added extensive references and workflow files for developing, modifying, debugging, and deploying PyFlink jobs, including artifact prep and dependency resolution.
- Introduced detailed guidance for DataFrame, AI, and multimodal features; clarified DataFrame/Table/SQL usage and source-of-truth requirements for API answers.
- Added connector access routes, capability references, and explicit version/source/contract checks for all coding and review workflows.
- Updated project and workflow navigation; removed deprecated files and updated documentation links.

Initial release focused on DataFrame-first PyFlink job support for Alibaba Cloud Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR):

- Implements clear workflow for PyFlink job authoring, review, and deployment artifact preparation.
- Enforces DataFrame-first coding unless user requests otherwise, with table/SQL use strictly regulated.
- Provides specific routing for read-only versus implementation tasks.
- Requires exact version (VVR 11.8+) for all target contracts; marks sources/sinks for user replacement where unclear.
- Integrates connector, dependency, and runtime file resolution per official documentation and skill-scoped references.
